# Surfaces v19

- Installed harnesses should take the verification-tool update. `verify affected` counts each
  repository path a recipe's scenario commands name as arguments, such as a fixture or a prompt,
  as covered by that recipe, so a change to one names the recipe that runs it instead of listing
  the path as one no recipe covers. Projects that verify their own way have no tool update to take.
